detail.longDescription: THE NEXT INDUSTRIAL REVOLUTION: AMERICAN ENERGY, COMPUTING, SUPERINTELLIGENCE, AND THE RACE TO BUILD THE FUTURE The discussion presents AI as the foundation of a new industrial economy linking energy, semiconductors, computing, algorithms, space infrastructure, and manufacturing. American competitiveness will depend on expanding power generation, secure AI systems, and domestic production while revitalizing communities. Responsible oversight, workforce development, and broad economic benefits are essential to sustaining superintelligence’s growth. https:// exlerstudio.wordpress.com/2026 /11/18/the-next-industrial-revolution-american-energy-computing-superintelligence-and-the-race-to-build-the-future/
